DEFECT-PAY-02 (Fixed): Material deductions were not applied to surgery and therapy when preset lacked deductsMaterialCosts. Synchronized surgery, therapy, and materialCostKop > 0 deductions.

DEFECT-PAY-04 (Fixed): Test advancedPayrollComponents.test.ts line 97 asserted zero lab deductions for CAD/CAM crown. Fixed to assert 800,000 kop ZTL deduction and accurate kopeck math.

DEFECT-PAY-05 (Fixed): calculateChairsideShiftEarnings lacked categoryRates support and DEFAULT_CATEGORY_COMMISSION_PERCENT fallback when service lacked explicit commissionPercent. Synchronized and verified with 5/5 unit tests.

Implemented ReportsDashboard.tsx with overall clinic average ticket, chair utilization by weekday and operating hour heatmap, patient flow primary share %, consultation-to-treatment funnel, zero dead-ends resilience on empty datasets, CSV export, and clean A4 print view.
